name: Dumbbells
description: Guidelines for traveling with dumbbells in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Heavy hand weights and dumbbells are not allowed in carry-on baggage (they can be used as bludgeons).

checkedBag.reason: Dumbbells and weights are allowed in checked baggage. Heavy bag charges may apply.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring dumbbells on a plane?

travelTips: Heavy hand weights and dumbbells are not allowed in carry-on baggage (they can be used as bludgeons).

faq.question: Is dumbbells allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Dumbbells is not_allowed in carry-on luggage. Heavy hand weights and dumbbells are not allowed in carry-on baggage (they can be used as bludgeons).

faq.question: Can you pack dumbbells in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Dumbbells is allowed in checked bags. Dumbbells and weights are allowed in checked baggage. Heavy bag charges may apply.
